name: Continual Flame
summary: Creates a heatless flame on an object that sheds light until dispelled.

stats.effect: A flame springs from an object that you touch. The effect casts Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet. It looks like a regular flame, but it creates no heat and consumes no fuel. The flame can be covered or hidden but not smothered or quenched.
